name: ModelVariant155_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant155_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (five cards orbit in front of the other slot trailing fading sparks over a spinning glowing cross, then a ring of dust rises and the screen flashes); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, builds the orbit path, packs five texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0, 4 while the cards orbit, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-172 and 302 images build it without the work-size printf and with a 256-line flash, so their data names bind 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
